verification.subject: Your {brand} verification code
verification.instructions: Enter it on the verification page to finish creating your account. The code expires in {minutes} min and stops working after {attempts} wrong attempts.
verification.neverShare: Never share this code. We will never ask you for it.
verification.ignore: If you did not create an account, ignore this message.

duplicate.subject: Someone tried to register with your email address
duplicate.exists: An account already exists for this address, so nothing was created.
duplicate.advice: If this was you, sign in instead. If it was not you, no action is needed: your account was not changed.

test.subject: {brand}: test message
test.body: This is a test message from the mail check. If you are reading it, verification codes will be delivered too.
